niran.note: Wants what you grew, not what you cooked -- the rivalry is about the harvest itself.

fah.note: Rare catches mean more to her than anything from the fields.

elder.note: Respects a proper offering; finds the hot season's chili a bit much.

child.note: Sweets over everything. Strong flavors are a hard no.

handler.note: Practical, hearty food. No stated reason for the papaya thing. There never is.

monk.note: Durian's smell isn't welcome in the temple, same as in most enclosed spaces -- a real, well-known custom, not a joke.

trader.note: Sees rice constantly at the stall -- a gift of it lands flat. Rare goods impress.
